source.quote: Official Enterprise Software Partner of Scottish Rugby and Men’s Back of Shorts Partner.

source.name: Scottish Rugby: Scottish Rugby and Macron launch new 2026/27 international kits
source.quote: Scottish Rugby, in partnership with Macron, have unveiled the international home kit to be worn on the world’s stage during season 2026/27
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. Official 2026/27 home replica product photos (authorised retailer Rugbystuff.com) show the Macron Hero logo on the right chest, the Scotland crest on the left, the Arnold Clark front wordmark, the Vodafone mark on the upper back, a Saltire flag patch on the left sleeve (national flag, not a commercial sponsor) and no other commercial marks on the sleeves.

summary: Arnold Clark is on the front of the 2026/27 navy home shirt, Vodafone on the back, Halo (Halo Service Solutions) on the back of the shorts, and Macron is the kit maker. Scottish Rugby's sponsors page documents front, back and shorts; the official product photos show the national flag as the only sleeve mark and no other sponsors.
